articles.what: Overlapping horizontal and vertical tartan plaid bands in classic Scottish weave — bold on satin Up close: Very large soft-edged tartan bands in red, magenta, purple and navy that cross at roughly right angles, with dark crossings. The edges are blurry like out-of-focus fabric; the repeat is bigger than this crop, and only a hint of fine thread grid shows. From a distance: Reads as a broad red-purple-blue colour wash with a faint check; at distance it is soft, moody colour blocking, not a crisp tartan. Group: Geometry, Deco & Op-Art. Texture detail: micro.

Dark
